description: This file contains unit tests for the ContentTypeValidationDirective class in a Java project. It verifies the content type validation logic within HTTP requests using the akka HTTP testing framework, focusing on correct behavior for valid, invalid, missing charset, and malformed content types.

classes.name: ContentTypeValidationDirectiveTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending JUnitRouteTest to verify the behavior of content type validation logic for HTTP requests, using mock objects and test HTTP requests with various content types.

methods.name: testValidContentType
methods.description: Tests that a request with a valid content type (application/json) passes validation and receives an OK status.

methods.name: testNonValidContentType
methods.description: Tests that a request with a non-matching content type results in an UnsupportedMediaTypeException.

methods.name: testWithContentTypeWithoutCharset
methods.description: Ensures that content types missing charset do not cause validation failures.

methods.name: testWithoutEntityNoNPEExpected
methods.description: Verifies that requests without an entity do not cause null pointer exceptions and are handled gracefully.

methods.name: testExceptionContainsDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks that the exception thrown contains the correct DittoHeaders data.

methods.name: testWithNonParsableContentType
methods.description: Simulates response to unparseable media types where headers are not correctly formatted, expecting validation to succeed.

methods.name: testWithUpperCaseContentTypeHeaderName
methods.description: Validates case-insensitive handling of the Content-Type header name.
